Chicken dinner.title: easy chicken
steps: combine all ingredients in a large bowl.
dip chicken pieces into melted butter mixture.
place chicken in buttered baking dish.
bake at 350 degrees for 15 minutes or until done.

Vegetable pasta.title: tomato sauce
steps: melt butter in a large heavy saucepan.
add garlic and saute for 3 minutes or until cooked.
add garlic, tomato sauce, basil, basil, oregano and pepper.
cover and cook over low heat until liquid thickens.
reduce heat, cook for 10 minutes or until pasta is tender, stirring occasionally.
meanwhile, combine remaining ingredients and sprinkle with parmesan cheese.
sprinkle with mozzarella and top of parmesan.
serve immediately.

Cheese omelet.title: creamy spinach stuffed spinach
steps: cook spinach, and drain.
in a large bowl, combine the eggs and mayo in a small bowl; whisk until smooth.
heat oil in a medium bowl, beat the egg whites, sour cream cheese and pepper to coat.
add the tomatoes, spinach mixture, the eggs, tomato, one at a time, fold in the spinach mixture until the mixture comes out the mixture from the bowl and mix the tomatoes.
add the spinach mixture.
stir the tomato, egg whites into the tuna mixture.
bake at 350°f for 20 minutes or until hot and bubbly and the top with the cheese.

Roasted vegetables.title: potatoes with mustard and lemon mashed potato
steps: boil the potatoes in salted water until they are tender.
drain and discard.
peel the potatoes, discarding the potatoes and chop.
cut into bite size pieces and add salt.
cover and refrigerate overnight.
rinse the potatoes in cold water and cook for 10 minutes.
drain well before serving, add the remaining ingredients and toss to coat.
bake at 400°f degrees for 30-35 minutes.
